scenarios.title: Display ticker without sponsor in landscape
scenarios.description: Verify ticker appears with intro → host name + tag → quoted text → loop → outro when no sponsor suffix is provided.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures the basic animation sequence runs exactly twice and contains the required elements when no sponsorship suffix is present.
scenarios.prerequisites: User is logged in and viewing the video player in landscape mode; player is playing; moderator console available.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Moderator publishes a promotional ticker with: hostNickname="HostOne" (8 chars), hostTag="Host", text="Big sale today", sponsorshipSuffix not provided, maxDisplayTime=30s.
2. Confirm user device is in landscape.
3. Observe the ticker animation.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker appears and plays: Intro → "HostOne" + "Host" → ""Big sale today"" → (no yellow dot) → (no sponsor) → repeats the whole sequence once more → Outro, then hides. Total loops: 2, no early termination.

scenarios.title: Display ticker with sponsor and yellow dot
scenarios.description: Verify yellow dot and sponsorship suffix appear only when sponsor is provided.
scenarios.testDescription: Validates optional elements render in correct order and style when sponsorship suffix is present.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape with player active.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Moderator publishes ticker: hostNickname="HostTwo", hostTag="Host", text="Limited time offer", sponsorshipSuffix="Sponsored by ACME", maxDisplayTime=30s.
2. Observe the sequence.
scenarios.expectedResult: Sequence shows Intro → "HostTwo" + "Host" → ""Limited time offer"" → yellow dot separator (visible) → "Sponsored by ACME" → repeats once → Outro. Yellow dot is absent only if sponsorshipSuffix is absent.

scenarios.title: Host nickname truncation to 10 characters
scenarios.description: Verify host name longer than 10 characters is truncated before display.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures compliance with nickname length limit and proper truncation without layout breakage.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; player ready.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Moderator publishes ticker: hostNickname="SuperLongHostName" (17 chars), hostTag="Host", text="Deal", maxDisplayTime=30s.
2. Observe the host name segment during animation.
scenarios.expectedResult: Displayed host name is truncated to 10 characters ("SuperLongH"). Truncation does not overlap UI. Host tag remains visible and aligned.

scenarios.title: Text length at 100 characters boundary
scenarios.description: Verify the text at the exact 100-character limit is accepted and displayed.
scenarios.testDescription: Confirms that the promotional text at maximum allowed length displays fully within quotes without overflow.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; player ready.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Prepare a 100-character text (e.g., repeat "1234567890" 10 times).
2. Moderator publishes ticker with hostNickname="Host100", hostTag="Host", text=<100-char string>, maxDisplayTime=30s.
3. Observe the text segment.
scenarios.expectedResult: The entire 100-character text appears enclosed in quotes without clipping, wrapping as per design, and with no overflow.

scenarios.title: Text length exceeding 100 characters is truncated
scenarios.description: Verify input text >100 characters is gracefully truncated to 100 before display.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures no more than 100 characters are shown even if the published text exceeds the limit.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; player ready.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Prepare a 120-character text (e.g., repeat "1234567890" 12 times).
2. Moderator publishes ticker with that text and maxDisplayTime=30s.
3. Observe the displayed text and count characters (excluding the quotes).
scenarios.expectedResult: Only the first 100 characters are displayed inside quotes. No layout issues or errors are shown.

scenarios.title: End by max display time before two loops complete
scenarios.description: Verify ticker ends when max display time is reached even if two loops are not complete.
scenarios.testDescription: Validates timing precedence: the shorter limit ends the animation.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; player ready.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Moderator publishes ticker with maxDisplayTime=3s (short), normal content.
2. Measure from first visible frame of the ticker.
3. Observe whether the ticker ends at or before 3s (plus brief outro, if designed).
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker ends due to reaching max display time before completing two loops. Outro plays immediately per design and ticker hides.

scenarios.title: End after exactly two loops
scenarios.description: Verify ticker completes exactly two full loops when time allows.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures loop count limitation is respected and no third loop starts.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; player ready.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Moderator publishes ticker with maxDisplayTime=60s, normal content.
2. Observe and count complete loops of the full sequence.
3. After second loop, watch for outro.
scenarios.expectedResult: Exactly two complete loops play, then outro. No third loop starts.

scenarios.title: Skip when less than 1 second remaining
scenarios.description: Verify ticker is skipped if time left to display is under 1 second.
scenarios.testDescription: Applies the minimum display time rule to avoid flashing content.
scenarios.prerequisites: User is about to enter landscape with a ticker published late.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Moderator publishes ticker with maxDisplayTime=5s.
2. Wait 4.2s.
3. Rotate user device to landscape (time left ≈0.8s).
4. Observe ticker.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker does not appear because remaining time is <1 second.

scenarios.title: Show when exactly 1 second remaining
scenarios.description: Verify ticker shows when exactly 1.0 second remains.
scenarios.testDescription: Edge case to confirm inclusive threshold for the minimum display time rule.
scenarios.prerequisites: User is about to enter landscape; timing control available.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Moderator publishes ticker with maxDisplayTime=5s.
2. At 4.0s elapsed (≈1.0s remaining), rotate device to landscape.
3. Observe ticker.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker appears and shows for at least 1 second (with graceful end/outro as time expires).

scenarios.title: CTA tap transitions to portrait with FZ open
scenarios.description: Verify tapping CTA transitions to portrait and opens FZ.
scenarios.testDescription: Checks navigation triggered by the ticker CTA and that the ticker is dismissed appropriately.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; ticker visible; CTA is present and tappable; FZ feature available.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. While ticker is visible, tap the CTA once.
2. Observe orientation and screen content.
scenarios.expectedResult: App transitions to portrait mode and FZ opens. The ticker is no longer visible.

scenarios.title: Dismiss tap hides ticker for current instance
scenarios.description: Verify tapping dismiss hides the ticker and it does not reappear for that ticker instance.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures dismiss action persists until the ticker naturally expires.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; ticker visible; dismiss control present.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Tap the dismiss control while ticker is visible.
2. Wait through the remaining max display time window.
3. Observe whether ticker reappears.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker hides immediately and does not reappear within its remaining time.

scenarios.title: Hide on player controls show; reappear after controls fade (time remains)
scenarios.description: Verify ticker hides when player controls appear and reappears after controls fade if time remains.
scenarios.testDescription: Confirms interaction between player controls overlay and the ticker visibility.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; ticker visible; player controls configured to auto-fade after ~3s.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Tap the video to show player controls while ticker is visible.
2. Observe that ticker hides immediately.
3. Do not interact further; allow controls to auto-fade.
4. Observe ticker visibility after fade.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker hides while controls are visible and reappears after controls fade, provided its time window has not expired.

scenarios.title: Hide on player controls show; no reappear if time expired
scenarios.description: Verify ticker does not reappear after controls fade if its time elapsed while controls were visible.
scenarios.testDescription: Tests the timing boundary when controls remain up long enough to consume remaining ticker time.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; ticker visible; remaining time ~2s; controls auto-fade ~3s.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. With approximately 2 seconds left on the ticker, tap to show controls.
2. Wait for controls to auto-fade (~3s).
3. Observe ticker visibility.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker does not reappear because the allowed display time expired while controls were visible.

scenarios.title: Orientation change pauses visibility
scenarios.description: Verify ticker is hidden in portrait and reappears on returning to landscape within allowed time.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures adherence to landscape-only display requirement and correct resumption upon returning.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; ticker visible; remaining time ≥5s.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Rotate device to portrait. Observe ticker.
2. Wait 2 seconds.
3. Rotate back to landscape within remaining time window.
4. Observe ticker.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker hides immediately in portrait and reappears on return to landscape if time remains.

scenarios.title: Quoted text formatting
scenarios.description: Verify the promotional text is enclosed in quotes as displayed.
scenarios.testDescription: Checks the presence and placement of quotes around the text regardless of content.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; ticker visible with various text inputs.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Publish text without internal quotes: text="Weekend deals" and observe ""Weekend deals"".
2. Publish text containing quotes: text="Save on \"gadgets\" now" and observe final rendering with outer quotes intact.
3. Publish text with emojis and punctuation.
scenarios.expectedResult: Text is consistently enclosed within a pair of display quotes, preserving inner characters correctly without breaking layout.

scenarios.title: Right-to-left (RTL) text and sponsor display
scenarios.description: Verify RTL languages render correctly with proper ordering and separators.
scenarios.testDescription: Confirms bidirectional text handling for Arabic or Hebrew content, including sponsor suffix and yellow dot placement.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; device/app supports RTL fonts; sample Arabic text available.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Moderator publishes ticker: hostNickname="مضيفطويلجدا" (11+ chars), hostTag="Host", text="عرض مميز اليوم", sponsorshipSuffix="برعاية الشركة", maxDisplayTime=30s.
2. Observe truncation of nickname to 10 visible RTL characters.
3. Verify sequence order and that the yellow dot visually separates text and sponsor appropriately for RTL.
scenarios.expectedResult: Nickname is truncated to 10 RTL characters; text appears quoted with correct RTL directionality; yellow dot and sponsor appear in proper RTL order and alignment.

scenarios.title: Rapid taps showing/hiding controls do not glitch ticker
scenarios.description: Verify stability when the user repeatedly shows/hides controls while ticker is active.
scenarios.testDescription: Stress test for state transitions between ticker visibility and controls overlay.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; ticker visible; controls auto-fade enabled.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. For 10 seconds, tap the player area every 0.8s to repeatedly show/hide controls.
2. Observe ticker behavior throughout.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker hides only while controls are visible and reappears reliably after fade if within time; no visual tearing or stuck states.

scenarios.title: Publish while already in landscape starts immediately
scenarios.description: Verify ticker starts as soon as it is published when the user is already in landscape.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures real-time responsiveness to moderator publishing events.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; player active; no current ticker.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. While user is in landscape, moderator publishes a new ticker.
2. Observe start timing.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker animation starts immediately (within network and processing latency), following the defined sequence.

scenarios.title: No yellow dot when sponsor is absent
scenarios.description: Verify the yellow dot separator is not shown when there is no sponsorship suffix.
scenarios.testDescription: Confirms optional separator is strictly tied to sponsor presence.
scenarios.prerequisites: User in landscape; ticker visible.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Publish ticker without sponsorshipSuffix.
2. Observe sequence between text and next elements.
scenarios.expectedResult: No yellow dot appears anywhere in the sequence.

scenarios.title: Telemetry/analytics events for ticker lifecycle
scenarios.description: Verify analytics events are emitted for show, complete, dismiss, and CTA.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures product analytics capture key user interactions and lifecycle states.
scenarios.prerequisites: Analytics logger available; ability to capture events; user in landscape.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Publish ticker and let it complete two loops without interaction.
2. Verify events: ticker_shown, ticker_completed.
3. Publish ticker and tap dismiss: verify ticker_shown, ticker_dismissed.
4. Publish ticker and tap CTA: verify ticker_shown, ticker_cta_clicked, navigation event.
scenarios.expectedResult: Expected analytics events are logged once per action with correct metadata (timestamp, host, text length, sponsor presence).

scenarios.title: Animation performance (FPS and jank)
scenarios.description: Ensure smooth animation at acceptable frame rates.
scenarios.testDescription: Measures rendering performance of the ticker across two loops.
scenarios.prerequisites: Performance profiler attached; mid-tier device; user in landscape.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Start a ticker with maxDisplayTime≥20s to allow two loops.
2. Record FPS and dropped frames during the full animation.
3. Repeat on low-end and high-end devices.
scenarios.expectedResult: Average FPS ≥55; 95th percentile frame time ≤20ms; dropped frames ≤1% of total; no visible stutter.

scenarios.title: Memory stability under repeated cycles
scenarios.description: Detect memory leaks when showing/hiding ticker repeatedly.
scenarios.testDescription: Runs multiple show/hide cycles and observes memory deltas.
scenarios.prerequisites: Memory profiler attached; automation to publish/expire tickers.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Run 100 cycles of ticker display (publish → two loops → end).
2. Capture heap snapshot before and after test.
3. Monitor retained objects related to ticker components.
scenarios.expectedResult: Peak memory increase ≤30MB during animation; post-test heap returns within 5MB of baseline; no retained ticker views/listeners.

scenarios.title: Touch responsiveness
scenarios.description: Measure latency for CTA and dismiss taps.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures user interactions are registered promptly.
scenarios.prerequisites: Input latency measurement tool; user in landscape with ticker visible.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Tap CTA and measure time to navigation start.
2. Tap dismiss and measure time to ticker disappearance.
scenarios.expectedResult: End-to-end tap latency ≤100ms for dismiss; ≤150ms to begin CTA transition.

scenarios.title: Accessibility - screen reader support
scenarios.description: Validate screen reader announces ticker content and controls.
scenarios.testDescription: Checks VoiceOver/TalkBack behavior and focus management.
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable VoiceOver (iOS) or TalkBack (Android); user in landscape.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. With ticker visible, swipe to navigate through accessibility elements.
2. Ensure the ticker region is announced (host, tag, text, sponsor if any) as a single concise announcement.
3. Focus CTA and dismiss; activate them with accessibility actions.
scenarios.expectedResult: Ticker content is announced clearly without repetition; CTA and dismiss are labeled and actionable; focus does not trap.

scenarios.title: Accessibility - color contrast and size
scenarios.description: Verify text contrast and hit target sizes meet guidelines.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures readability and operability for all users.
scenarios.prerequisites: WCAG contrast checker; design specs; device in landscape.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Measure contrast ratio of ticker text vs background and yellow dot visibility.
2. Measure CTA and dismiss touch targets.
3. Test with dynamic text sizes (OS font scaling).
scenarios.expectedResult: Contrast ratio ≥4.5:1 for text; touch targets ≥44x44 pt (iOS) / 48x48 dp (Android); layout remains usable with large text.

scenarios.title: Battery impact during prolonged usage
scenarios.description: Assess power consumption when tickers run repeatedly.
scenarios.testDescription: Quantifies additional battery drain attributable to the ticker animations.
scenarios.prerequisites: Power profiler available; device at stable brightness and network conditions.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Run a 30-minute session with tickers appearing every 60s.
2. Compare to a 30-minute baseline session without tickers.
scenarios.expectedResult: Additional power drain ≤10% over baseline on mid-tier hardware; no thermal throttling triggered.

scenarios.title: Network resiliency and offline behavior
scenarios.description: Ensure no crashes or hangs when connectivity drops during display.
scenarios.testDescription: Validates that once the ticker starts, it continues smoothly even if network conditions change.
scenarios.prerequisites: Network link conditioner; user in landscape.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Start a ticker, then toggle network to offline.
2. Observe the ongoing animation and completion.
3. Attempt to publish a new ticker while offline.
scenarios.expectedResult: Current ticker continues and ends normally; publishing while offline is handled gracefully with user-safe messaging/logs; no crash.

scenarios.title: Layout across devices and safe areas
scenarios.description: Verify visual layout on various screen sizes and notches.
scenarios.testDescription: Ensures text, yellow dot, and controls align and do not overlap safe areas.
scenarios.prerequisites: Device matrix including phones/tablets with notches and rounded corners.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Display ticker on small phone, large phone, and tablet in landscape.
2. Inspect alignment, truncation, and safe-area insets.
3. Test with long sponsor suffix and max-length text.
scenarios.expectedResult: No clipping or overlap; elements remain within safe areas; truncation rules hold; visuals match design.

scenarios.title: Stability under rapid state changes
scenarios.description: Verify no crashes when rapidly changing orientation and controls.
scenarios.testDescription: Stress test for state management and race conditions.
scenarios.prerequisites: Automation or manual rapid interaction; crash logs enabled.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. While ticker is visible, rapidly rotate device between landscape and portrait 10 times.
2. Simultaneously tap to show/hide controls intermittently.
3. Repeat across two tickers.
scenarios.expectedResult: No crashes or ANRs; ticker visibility rules remain consistent; app state recovers cleanly.

scenarios.title: Event logging integrity
scenarios.description: Ensure no duplicate or missing logs for ticker lifecycle.
scenarios.testDescription: Validates that logs are idempotent and correctly correlated.
scenarios.prerequisites: Access to log stream; correlation IDs in place.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Trigger show, dismiss, CTA, and complete scenarios.
2. Verify exactly one log per action with consistent ticker ID and timestamps in order.
3. Simulate app background/foreground transitions during ticker.
scenarios.expectedResult: Logs are complete, ordered, and de-duplicated with valid IDs; backgrounding does not cause duplicates.
